hints.title: Bilateral Inward Vowel Scan
hints.text: Only vowel characters swap positions while consonants stay fixed. How can scanning inward simultaneously from both ends locate the outward-most vowels?

hints.title: Independent Pointer Advancement Invariant
hints.text: Advance the left index while its character is non-vocalic, and retreat the right index while its character is non-vocalic. When both locate vowels, exchange them.

hints.title: Character Array Inward Swap Procedure
hints.text: Convert the string to a mutable character list. Initialize pointers at the beginning and end. Move left forward until finding a vowel and right backward until finding a vowel. If left is less than right, swap the characters and advance both pointers. Convert the list back to a string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting vowels into an intermediate list and then performing multiple string replaces takes quadratic O(N^2) time due to string immutability.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A two-pointer pass over the mutable character list swaps vowels in place in O(N) time and requires O(N) space for the character array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle both lowercase and uppercase vowels and execute the clean two-pointer traversal.
